name: Baseline & Readiness
activities: Complete diagnostic, establish KPI baseline, secure sponsorship
deliverables: Readiness score, baseline KPIs, sponsor commitment

name: Process Discovery
activities: Observe, transcribe, extract AP process; map exceptions and controls
deliverables: Process map, exception taxonomy, control map

name: Agent Specification
activities: Select first agent; write charter, controls, KPIs
deliverables: Agent charter, control matrix, test plan

name: Data & Tool Access
activities: Configure read access, APIs, historical data for testing

name: Prototype
activities: Build agent logic; test against historical cases

name: Historical Testing
activities: Run agent against 3+ months historical data

name: Shadow Mode
activities: Agent operates without action permissions; compare to human

name: Performance Review
activities: Evaluate KPIs against targets; decide on progression

name: Responsibility Progression
activities: Earn higher autonomy through demonstrated performance

name: Scale
activities: Add agents, expand scope, continuous improvement
